answer_1.quote: Math problems are crucial means of knowledge propagation and learning assessment in teaching, but the high cost of manual compilation can no longer meet the growing demand for personalized learning.

answer_2.quote: Following previous research , we employ two commonly used metrics to compare the quality of our synthesized SFT data with human-written data (5000 samples randomly selected from each): perplexity (PPL) and BERTScore.

answer_3.quote: Following previous research , we employ two commonly used metrics to compare the quality of our synthesized SFT data with human-written data (5000 samples randomly selected from each): perplexity (PPL) and BERTScore. A lower PPL indicates better output, and we use Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct to calculate PPL.
